lines.text: In a small coffee shop, the barista slides a cup across the counter to @sai_front, who takes the first sip and closes his eyes.

new_beats.text: @sai_front opens his eyes and smiles, wrapping both hands around the cup.

writes.note: I added a closing beat where Sai opens his eyes and smiles, so the sip has a payoff.

reply.rationale: The shot ends on the sip with no reaction. A short smiling beat after it gives the moment a payoff. The existing words stay as they are.
